2292-3240-6462-8347.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Nether Traitor.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Kheru Goldkeeper and Sela triggers, creating a Treasure token and a creature token
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

3518-3605-3668-5131.description:
Cast Lion's Eye Diamond from your graveyard using Muldrotha by paying {0}.
Activate Lion's Eye Diamond by sacrificing it and discarding your hand, adding three mana of any one color.
Cast Flesh Duplicate by paying {U}{U}, causing it to enter with vanishing 3 as a copy of Muldrotha.
Put the original Muldrotha into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Cast Lion's Eye Diamond from your graveyard using the new Muldrotha by paying {0}.
Activate Lion's Eye Diamond by sacrificing it and discarding your hand, adding three mana of any one color.
Cast Dance of the Dead by paying {1}{B}.
When Dance of the Dead enters, it triggers, returning Muldrotha from the graveyard to the battlefield tapped with Dance of the Dead attached to it.
Put the copy of Muldrotha into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Repeat.

1115-4770-5301-6006.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
Rin and Seri triggers, creating a 1/1 Dog creature token.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Dog token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

81-512-2872.easyPrerequisites:
Kami of Whispered Hopes and Clever Conjurer do not have summoning sickness.
Kami of Whispered Hopes has power 2 or greater.
81-512-2872.description:
Activate Kami of Whispered Hopes by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}
Activate Clever Conjurer by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping Clever Conjurer and Kami of Whispered Hopes, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Clever Conjurer ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.
81-512-2872.notes: Once you have drawn your library, you may instead forego activating Kami of Whispered Hopes's ability to activate Halo Fountain's first ability to create near-infinite 1/1 Citizen creature tokens.

618-1734-8095.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Fiend Hunter.
When the Fiend Hunter token enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Kiki-Jiki until Fiend Hunter leaves the battlefield.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the Fiend Hunter token.
When the Fiend Hunter token dies, Kiki-Jiki is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

1368-5434-6321-7763.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
1368-5434-6321-7763.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

uses.exileCardState: exiled on a previous turn by its paradigm ability

147-1409-2060-7453.manaNeeded: {1}{U} plus {3}{G}{G} if Germination Practicum is in your hand
147-1409-2060-7453.description:
If Germination Practicum is in your hand, cast Germination Practicum by paying {3}{G}{G}. Otherwise, at the beginning of your precombat main phase, choose to cast a copy of it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, activate Dualcaster Mage by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, pairing it and Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Germination Practicum.
Resolve the copy of Germination Practicum, putting two +1/+1 counters on each creature you control.
Holding priority, activate Crystalline Crawler twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

1563-3899-4478-6441.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

3000-4875-7304.description:
Cast Genghis Frog by paying {G}{U}
When Genghis Frog enters, it triggers, creating a Mutagen token and a creature token due to Chatterfang.
When the creature token enters as a Mutant due to Conspiracy, Genghis Frog triggers, creating a Mutagen token and a creature token due to Chatterfang.
Repeat step 3.
3000-4875-7304.notes: Step 3 creates a mandatory infinite loop that will cause the game to end in a draw if it isn't interacted with.

uses.battlefieldCardState: is paired with Patron of the Arts

1409-1652-2499.description:
Activate Patron of the Arts by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Patron of the Arts enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger twice.
Resolve both Deadeye Navigator triggers, repairing it and Patron of the Arts.
Resolve both Patron of the Arts triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

1483-2921-6972--112.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Weaponcraft Enthusiast.
When Weaponcraft Enthusiast dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Weaponcraft Enthusiast enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.
1483-2921-6972--112.notes: The chosen anthem effect must boost Weaponcraft Enthusiast's toughness by at least 1 so it doesn't die from the -1/-1 counter.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

4907-5330-6972.description:
Activate Atog by sacrificing Tatterkite
When Tatterkite dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its static effect.
Resolve the Atog ability.
Repeat.

488-1414-2895-3200-4986.notablePrerequisites: One of either Lotus Petal or Urza's Bauble must be in your hand, with the other in your graveyard.
488-1414-2895-3200-4986.description:
Cast the artifact in your hand by paying {0}.
Teshar triggers, returning Uro from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Uro enters the battlefield, its first and second abilities and Loran trigger.
Resolve the first Uro trigger, sacrificing it.
Resolve the second Uro trigger, causing you to gain 3 life and draw a card, and allowing you to put a land card from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Loran trigger, returning the other {0} cost artifact from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the spell cast in step 1.
Activate the {0} cost artifact by sacrificing it.
Repeat.

618-3742-5231.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Phantom Steed.
When the Phantom Steed token enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Kiki-Jiki until Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Phantom Steed token, adding {R}.
When the Phantom Steed token dies, Kiki-Jiki is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat.

4971-6092.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
4971-6092.description:
Draw a card.
Niv-Mizzet, the Firemind triggers, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Niv-Mizzet, Visionary triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

2315-3946-5967.description:
Play Glacial Chasm either from your hand or from your graveyard.
When Glacial Chasm enters the battlefield, its second ability triggers, causing you to sacrifice another land you control.
Play any land from your graveyard.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Glacial Chasm's cumulative upkeep ability triggers, allowing you to choose not to pay the cost and sacrifice it instead.
Repeat.

168-526-4094-5193.manaNeeded: {2}{W}{B}{G} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
168-526-4094-5193.notablePrerequisites: Kaya has at least two loyalty counters on it.
168-526-4094-5193.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Cast Anikthea from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{W}{B}{G} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Anikthea enters the battlefield, it and Life Finds a Way trigger.
Resolve the Anikthea trigger, exiling Oblivion Ring from your graveyard and creating two token copies of it that are 3/3 Zombies.
When the Oblivion Ring tokens enter the battlefield, their first abilities trigger.
Resolve the first Oblivion Ring trigger, exiling Anikthea until the Oblivion Ring token leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the second Oblivion Ring trigger, exiling the first Oblivion Ring token.
When the first Oblivion Ring token is exiled, Anikthea returns to the battlefield from exile.
When Anikthea enters the battlefield, it and Life Finds a Way trigger.
Resolve the Anikthea trigger, choosing not to exile anything.
Resolve the Life Finds a Way trigger, creating two token copies of the Oblivion Ring token.
Repeat from step 5.

876-2703-4365-4659.description:
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Myr Propagator.
Activate Myr Propagator by paying {3} and tapping it, creating two token copies of itself.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing the tapped Myr Propagator and a Myr Propagator token, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the Myr Propagator tokens.

682-1409-2060-5296.notablePrerequisites: Deadeye Navigator is paired with Supply Runners.
682-1409-2060-5296.description:
Activate Supply Runners by paying {1}{U}, blinking itself.
When Supply Runners enters the battlefield, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Supply Runners.
Resolve the Supply Runners trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on each other creature you control.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {U}.
Activate Workhorse by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

719-1147-2034.description:
Cast Grovetender Druids by paying {2}{G}{W}.
When Grovetender Druids enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Plant creature token.
When the Plant enters the battlefield as an Ally due to Xenograft, Grovetender Druids triggers.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Plant, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Grovetender Druids trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Plant creature token.
Repeat from step 3.
Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the Plants.

576-927.description:
At the beginning of your end step, Jon Irenicus triggers, giving control of Vodalian Knights to an opponent who controls no Islands.
When Vodalian Knights's controller controls no Islands, Vodalian Knights triggers, causing them to sacrifice it.
However, Vodalian Knights cannot be sacrificed due to its ability.
Vodalian Knights triggers again, creating a mandatory infinite loop that causes the game to end in a draw.

1940-2034-4963.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one creature.
1940-2034-4963.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature, adding {C}{C}.
The creature dies, triggering Liliana.
Holding priority, activate Words of Wilding by paying {1}, causing you to create a 2/2 Bear creature token the next time you would draw a card this turn.
Resolve the Liliana trigger, creating a 2/2 Bear creature token.
Repeat.

240-439-643-2034.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Arashin Sovereign, adding {C}{C}.
Arashin Sovereign dies, triggering itself and Atla Palani.
Resolve the Arashin Sovereign trigger, putting it on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Atla Palani trigger, revealing Arashin Sovereign from the top of your library and putting it onto the battlefield.
Repeat.

23-447-776-1329.notablePrerequisites: Emry and Orcish Vandal do not have summoning sickness.
23-447-776-1329.description:
Tap Orcish Vandal, sacrificing Gustha's Scepter to deal 2 damage to any target.
Tap Emry, targeting Gustha's Scepter.
Cast Gustha's Scepter.
Jeskai Ascendancy triggers, allowing you to loot.
Jeskai Ascendancy triggers, untapping all creatures you control and giving them +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.
